subject: Regional failover audit artifacts & simulated restore logistics
messages:
From: Emma Richards <emma.richards@finserve.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-05T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Request: regional failover audit artifacts & simulated restore logistics

Sergio —

Thanks for taking this. Clearwater Compliance is prepping a regional failover review for our board next month; they asked FinServe to collect vendor-level evidence showing your multi-region failover capabilities and a recent simulated restore. Specifically we need:

- A short runbook (or excerpt) that was used for the most recent simulated recovery
- RTO/RPO evidence for the affected services (measured times and scope)
- Logs or CSV showing the restore run and timings (start/complete for key steps)
- Any post-test incident notes or deviations from expected behavior

Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide and whether you can run a short simulated restore in our tenanted region the week of Apr 9 so Clearwater can observe? Ideally we get initial artifacts by EOD Apr 8 and the simulated run recorded Apr 9–10.

Let me know if you need details on the scope (list of API endpoints and S3 buckets) — I can send that in a follow-up.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Emma
Emma Richards
Senior Risk Manager, FinServe Capital
emma.richards@finserve.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Richards <emma.richards@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: regional failover audit artifacts & simulated restore logistics

Emma —

Thanks for the heads up. We can provide the items you listed. Quick summary of what I can share immediately and what we propose for the observed drill:

Immediately available (attached):
- runbook-v2.pdf (excerpted recovery steps we used for last tabletop exercise)
- high-level RTO/RPO summary (service-level timings; see runbook appendix)

For the observed simulated restore (proposed):
- Proposed window: 2027-04-09 08:00–12:00 PDT (we can keep it to a 4-hour window and limit scope to API layer + primary object store)
- We'll produce a CSV of the restore timestamps (start/step/complete) and a short video capture (screen + logs) of the orchestration console.
- Post-test deliverables: restore_log_20270409.csv, DR-drill-checklist.xlsx, short test summary + deviations.

A few notes/asks:
- We need your confirmed list of endpoints and the bucket prefixes that should be included in the simulation (to scope data restoration).
- If Clearwater wants to observe from their side, we'll add audit observers to the session (read-only).
- We'll redact customer identifiers from logs; if you need unredacted material we can run a limited environment with FinServe test data (requires a small compute spin-up).

Attaching runbook excerpt now. I'll coordinate the drill day runbook with Marissa and Grace and share the CSV/video after the run.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Reliability & Operations
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Attach: runbook-v2.pdf (excerpt)

Emma / Sergio —

Adding a few clarifications from the DR ops side. We ran a scoped restore for a partner test on 2027-03-28; attaching the snapshot retention policy and the raw restore log for that run. Items attached: snapshot-policy.csv, restore_log_20270328.csv.

Notes:
- For the April observed run we'll limit the scope to the following FinServe prefixes: /fs-prod/orders, /fs-prod/ledger. Confirm if you want /fs-prod/objects too.
- Measured RTOs from 2027-03-28 run: auth service 2m40s (90th pct), api gateway 1m10s, object index restore 28m. We can provide the full percentile distribution if Clearwater wants deeper detail.
- We'll run the April test against a dedicated test tenant to avoid any customer-facing risk; timings are representative of production when using warm prefixes.

I'll prepare the DR-drill-checklist.xlsx and the updated restore_log_20270409.csv after the simulated run.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Ops Enablement, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attach: snapshot-policy.csv, restore_log_20270328.csv

Sergio / Marissa —

Thanks, that looks good. A couple of follow-ups from the audit team:

- Clearwater wants a short unedited recording of the orchestration console and logs (no PII) — is the S3 link above (s3.redwood.internal/...) accessible for read-only streaming?
- They also asked for the runbook steps mapped to time stamps in the CSV so they can verify each step was executed in order.
- Please confirm whether the RPO numbers are measured from snapshot-start or last-write replication. We need that for the audit statement.

If everything is in place we confirm the observer slot for Apr 09 09:00–10:30 PDT.

Best —
Emma

Date: 2027-04-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: regional failover audit artifacts & simulated restore logistics

Emma / team —

Confirming the final deliverables and logistics after the simulated restore performed 2027-04-09 (recording available). Summary:

Delivered artifacts (attached / uploaded):
- restore_log_20270409.csv (step-level timestamps; includes step IDs and durations)
- DR-drill-checklist.xlsx (checklist used during the run)
- runbook-v2.pdf (excerpt, updated to call out redaction rules)
- snapshot-policy.csv (retention and snapshot cadence)
- recovery-test-video: https://s3.redwood.internal/recovery-test/videos/finserve-20270409.mp4 (read-only streaming link)

Key measured outcomes (short):
- Scope used: /fs-prod/orders, /fs-prod/ledger (no live customer traffic)
- RTO (measured): API layer 1m20s (median), object index restore 29m12s (median)
- RPO definition used: measured from last-write replication marker (we included this column in restore_log_20270409.csv)
- Deviations: a background re-index job delayed final object availability by ~3m (logged in restore_log); listed as post-test remediation in the checklist.

Audit observers: Clearwater Compliance joined in read-only and confirmed timestamps matched runbook steps. We redacted customer identifiers per your request; if you require unredacted records for legal review we can run a short isolated replay in a test tenant (requires confirmation and a signed NDA addendum).

Next steps:
- I uploaded the artifacts to the shared Drive and linked them in the HubSpot record (HS-483920).
- If Clearwater needs any clarifying notes for the board pack, Marissa and I can prepare a 1-page attestation (signed) describing the methodology and controls.

Let me know if you want the attestation; otherwise consider these items delivered.

Best —
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Reliability & Operations
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Attach: restore_log_20270409.csv, DR-drill-checklist.xlsx
